(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to the destination, wherein the surface portion includes at least one feature that facilitates cleaning of the surface portion.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity and wherein the second quantity is transferred using a deliberate, controlled motion.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 1 wherein: a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and b. the surface portion includes at least one feature designed to avoid trapping cosmetics and facilitate cleaning of the surface portion.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without any outwardly extending protrusions.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar, excluding any features intended for enhancing usability.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by a mechanism that allows for adjustability in the fit of the ring portion to accommodate different finger sizes.
